Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer hallucinated the manufacturer of the ASM-N-5 Gorgon V in its second search result. While the first search correctly identified "Glenn L. Martin Company," the second search (Step 2) returned results where the text explicitly stated "developed by the Lockheed MartinCompany" (a conflation of the historical company and the modern entity). Instead of recognizing this as an error or a search result anomaly and correcting the record, the WebSurfer accepted this hallucinated text as fact. This error was compounded by the Planner, who failed to verify the source text and incorrectly concluded that the builder was "Lockheed Martin" based on this flawed retrieval, leading to the wrong final answer.
